description: Source code for testing lazy initialization and hash table performance in a version control system, including functions for dumping hash tables, timing runs, and analyzing multi-threaded performance.

classes.name: struct dir_entry
classes.description: Represents a directory entry with hash, parent, name length, and name.

methods.name: dump_run
methods.description: Dumps the contents of directory and name hash tables to stdout for verification.

methods.name: time_runs
methods.description: Runs the hash table initialization multiple times and reports timing, for single or multi-threaded modes.

methods.name: analyze_run
methods.description: Analyzes performance across different cache sizes to optimize multi-threaded performance.

methods.name: cmd__lazy_init_name_hash
methods.description: Main command function handling options for dumping, timing, and analyzing hash table performance.
